direction: Logic & feeling: one continuous thought across development and writing

references.lesson: Oversized typography and clear project hierarchy; study viewed in the browser.
Award listing used as a reference, not a claim about this portfolio.
A coherent visual storytelling premise; main content reviewed, heavyweight opening could not be fully inspected in the browser.
Interaction that expresses an identity rather than a collection of unrelated effects.
Native vertical scrolling, scoped animation cleanup and motion linked to actual visible sections.
Honor intrinsic image proportions instead of forcing different source covers into identical frames.

decisions: No custom cursor, magnetic controls or floating pointer labels.
No horizontal project reel or scroll hijacking.
Generative projected knot drawn locally; stops when offscreen and respects Motion off.
Projects use actual asset dimensions with complete uncropped previews.
Alternating project chapters, staggered print-like writing covers, service accordions, portrait and chronological journey.
Reviews advance only on explicit controls.
All 21 restored service and location pages retained.
